Today marks 11 years since the senseless and tragic murder of nine innocent souls at Mother Emanuel AME Church in Charleston.

When it seemed like evil would prevail, in the end, it did not triumph. Through the strength and grace of God, the people of South Carolina came together in a way that I hadn’t seen in a long time.

May God continue to bless the victims’ families and Mother Emanuel AME Church.
